newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint seeks 1,891,000 kg of copper.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint seeks 1,891,000 kg of copper.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said it was seeking 1,891,000 kg of electrolytic copper cathodes for delivery to processors in the weeks of November 11 or November 18.
The Mint said it would review offers at 10 a.m. EDT (1400 GMT) on October 21.

It sought 904,000 kg by rail to Olin Corp in East Alton, Illinois; 904,000 kg by rail to PMX Industries in Cedar Rapids, Iowa; 36,287 kg by truck to Alltrista Corp in Delaware, Ohio; 26,713 kg by truck to Alltrista Corp in Shelby, North Carolina; and 20,000 kg by truck to LaSalle Rolling Mills in Carrollton, Georgia.
